gloss: frequent; repeated; occurring in many instances

definitions.gloss: frequent; repeated; occurring in many instances
definitions.explanation: Describes events or phenomena that happen many times or in many locations. Often used in news and formal reporting to characterize incidents, accidents, or outbreaks that occur repeatedly.

examples.japanese: {多発的|たはつてき}な{事故|じこ}が{続|つづ}いた。
この{地域|ちいき}では{多発的|たはつてき}に{地震|じしん}が{起|お}きている。
examples.english: Earthquakes are occurring frequently in this region.

examples.japanese: {多発的|たはつてき}な{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}の{報告|ほうこく}を{受|う}けて、{保健所|ほけんじょ}が{調査|ちょうさ}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: In response to frequent reports of food poisoning, the public health center launched an investigation.

notes:
Composed of {多発|たはつ} (frequent occurrence) and {的|てき} (adjectival suffix). Used primarily in formal or news-style contexts to describe problems, incidents, or phenomena that happen repeatedly or in many places. The nuance tends to emphasize a pattern of repeated occurrences rather than a single spike.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多発的|たはつてき}な{事故|じこ}: frequent accidents
- {多発的|たはつてき}な{犯罪|はんざい}: repeated crimes
- {多発的|たはつてき}に{発生|はっせい}する: to occur frequently
- {多発的|たはつてき}な{被害|ひがい}: widespread damage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}: frequent — more general and used in everyday conversation
- {多発|たはつ}: frequent occurrence — the noun form, often used as a prefix (e.g., {多発|たはつ}{事故|じこ})
- {散発的|さんぱつてき}: sporadic — occurring at irregular intervals, less concentrated than {多発的|たはつてき}
